text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, or noticed a decrease in fetal movement? I need to assess for signs of pre-eclampsia or fetal distress given your symptoms and gestational age.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any diarrhea or nausea, and have you noticed any skin rashes or changes in your urine output? I suspect Listeriosis given the ice cream consumption, so I need to rule out other causes like UTIs or viral infections.
